query: SELECT [Year] AS year,[Mk] AS make,[Cn] AS commercialName,[T] AS type,[Va] AS variant,[Ve] AS version,[Ft] AS fuel,[Ec (cm3)] AS engineCc,[Ep (KW)] AS powerKw,[W (mm)] AS wheelbaseMm,[M (kg)] AS massKg,COUNT(*) AS observations FROM [CO2Emission].[latest].[co2cars] WHERE [Year]=2021 AND [Status]='F' AND [Mk] IS NOT NULL AND [Cn] IS NOT NULL GROUP BY [Year],[Mk],[Cn],[T],[Va],[Ve],[Ft],[Ec (cm3)],[Ep (KW)],[W (mm)],[M (kg)]
